t: A second prayer for Abū Hurayrah's mother
a: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ عُبَيْدَكَ هَذَا - يَعْنِي أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ وَأُمَّهُ - إِلَى عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَحَبِّبْ إِلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
p: Allāhumma ḥabbib ʿubaydaka hādhā wa ummahu ila ʿibādika-l-mu'minīn, wa ḥabbib ilayhimu-l-mu'minīn.
m: O Allah, make this servant of Yours and his mother beloved to Your believing servants, and make the believers beloved to them.
